query:
with scope as materialized(select exists(select 1 from collect_ops.exceptions e where e.id='89803f3e-08b6-4e9d-ae06-26244952a6f7'::uuid
  and collect_operator_audit.exception_scope_v2(e.source_kind,e.source_id))available),
 events as not materialized(
  (select collect_operator_audit.exception_event_id('exception_action',r.request_id)event_id,
   'exception_action'::text source,r.request_id source_record_id,'exception.'||r.action action,r.recorded_at,
   'operator'::text actor_kind,r.actor_id,r.request_id,r.expected_revision revision,null::bigint workflow_revision,
   null::uuid escalation_id,r.reason_code,'immutable_request'::text origin,null::uuid assignee_id,null::timestamptz due_at
   from collect_ops.exception_actions r where r.exception_id='89803f3e-08b6-4e9d-ae06-26244952a6f7'::uuid
    and r.recorded_at>='0001-01-01T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz and r.recorded_at<='2026-10-01T15:36:07.860693Z'::timestamptz
    and('2026-10-01T15:36:07.860693Z'::timestamptz is null or(r.recorded_at,collect_operator_audit.exception_event_id('exception_action',r.request_id))<('2026-10-01T15:36:07.860693Z'::timestamptz,'ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid))
   order by r.recorded_at desc,collect_operator_audit.exception_event_id('exception_action',r.request_id)desc limit 20+1)
  union all (select collect_operator_audit.exception_event_id('exception_workflow_request',r.request_id),
   'exception_workflow_request',r.request_id,'exception.workflow.'||r.action,r.recorded_at,'operator',r.actor_id,r.request_id,
   r.expected_source_revision,(r.result->>'workflow_revision')::bigint,
   case when r.action='escalate'then collect_operator_audit.safe_uuid(r.result->>'escalation_id')end,r.reason_code,
   'immutable_request',case when r.action='assign'then r.assignee_id end,case when r.action='assign'then r.due_at end
   from collect_ops.exception_workflow_requests r where r.exception_id='89803f3e-08b6-4e9d-ae06-26244952a6f7'::uuid
    and r.recorded_at>='0001-01-01T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz and r.recorded_at<='2026-10-01T15:36:07.860693Z'::timestamptz
    and('2026-10-01T15:36:07.860693Z'::timestamptz is null or(r.recorded_at,collect_operator_audit.exception_event_id('exception_workflow_request',r.request_id))<('2026-10-01T15:36:07.860693Z'::timestamptz,'ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid))
   order by r.recorded_at desc,collect_operator_audit.exception_event_id('exception_workflow_request',r.request_id)desc limit 20+1)
  union all (select collect_operator_audit.exception_event_id('exception_escalation_event',r.id),
   'exception_escalation_event',r.id,'exception.escalation.'||r.action,r.recorded_at,r.actor_kind,r.actor_id,null::uuid,
   r.source_revision,null::bigint,r.escalation_id,e.reason_code,r.origin,null::uuid,null::timestamptz
   from collect_ops.exception_escalation_events r join collect_ops.exception_escalations e on e.id=r.escalation_id
   where r.exception_id='89803f3e-08b6-4e9d-ae06-26244952a6f7'::uuid
    and r.recorded_at>='0001-01-01T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz and r.recorded_at<='2026-10-01T15:36:07.860693Z'::timestamptz
    and('2026-10-01T15:36:07.860693Z'::timestamptz is null or(r.recorded_at,collect_operator_audit.exception_event_id('exception_escalation_event',r.id))<('2026-10-01T15:36:07.860693Z'::timestamptz,'ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid))
   order by r.recorded_at desc,collect_operator_audit.exception_event_id('exception_escalation_event',r.id)desc limit 20+1)
 ),page as materialized(select * from events where(select available from scope)
  and recorded_at>='0001-01-01T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz and recorded_at<='2026-10-01T15:36:07.860693Z'::timestamptz
  and('2026-10-01T15:36:07.860693Z'::timestamptz is null or(recorded_at,event_id)<('2026-10-01T15:36:07.860693Z'::timestamptz,'ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid))
  order by recorded_at desc,event_id desc limit 20+1),
 shown as materialized(select * from page order by recorded_at desc,event_id desc limit 20)
 select jsonb_build_object('contract_version',2,'scope','rw_operator_entity_audit','entity_kind','exception',
  'entity_id','89803f3e-08b6-4e9d-ae06-26244952a6f7'::uuid,'status',case when(select available from scope)then 'available'else 'unavailable'end,
  'checked_at',collect_ops.utc('2026-10-01T15:36:07.860693Z'::timestamptz),'sample_valid_until',collect_ops.utc('2026-10-01T15:36:07.860693Z'::timestamptz+interval '60 seconds'),
  'limit',20,'history_complete',false,'financial_action',false,'send_action',false,
  'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('event_id',event_id,'source',source,
   'source_record_id',source_record_id,'action',action,'recorded_at',collect_ops.utc(recorded_at),
   'actor_kind',actor_kind,'actor_id',actor_id,'request_id',request_id,'revision',revision,
   'workflow_revision',workflow_revision,'escalation_id',escalation_id,'reason_code',reason_code,
   'origin',origin,'assignee_id',assignee_id,'due_at',collect_ops.utc(due_at))order by recorded_at desc,event_id desc)from shown),'[]'::jsonb),
  'next_cursor',case when(select count(*)from page)>20 then
   (select jsonb_build_object('recorded_at',collect_ops.utc(recorded_at),'event_id',event_id)
    from shown order by recorded_at,event_id limit 1)else null end)

Plans.Filter: (("*SELECT* 1".recorded_at >= '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND ("*SELECT* 1".recorded_at <= '2026-10-01 15:36:07.860693+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (ROW("*SELECT* 1".recorded_at, "*SELECT* 1".event_id) < ROW('2026-10-01 15:36:07.860693+00'::timestamp with time zone, 'ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid)))

Plans.Index Cond: ((exception_id = '89803f3e-08b6-4e9d-ae06-26244952a6f7'::uuid) AND (recorded_at >= '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (recorded_at <= '2026-10-01 15:36:07.860693+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (ROW(recorded_at, collect_operator_audit.exception_event_id('exception_action'::text, request_id)) < ROW('2026-10-01 15:36:07.860693+00'::timestamp with time zone, 'ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid)))

Plans.Filter: (("*SELECT* 2".recorded_at >= '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND ("*SELECT* 2".recorded_at <= '2026-10-01 15:36:07.860693+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (ROW("*SELECT* 2".recorded_at, "*SELECT* 2".exception_event_id) < ROW('2026-10-01 15:36:07.860693+00'::timestamp with time zone, 'ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid)))

((recorded_at >= '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (recorded_at <= '2026-10-01 15:36:07.860693+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (exception_id = '89803f3e-08b6-4e9d-ae06-26244952a6f7'::uuid) AND (ROW(recorded_at, collect_operator_audit.exception_event_id('exception_workflow_request'::text, request_id)) < ROW('2026-10-01 15:36:07.860693+00'::timestamp with time zone, 'ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid)))

(("*SELECT* 3".recorded_at >= '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND ("*SELECT* 3".recorded_at <= '2026-10-01 15:36:07.860693+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (ROW("*SELECT* 3".recorded_at, "*SELECT* 3".exception_event_id) < ROW('2026-10-01 15:36:07.860693+00'::timestamp with time zone, 'ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid)))

((recorded_at >= '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (recorded_at <= '2026-10-01 15:36:07.860693+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (exception_id = '89803f3e-08b6-4e9d-ae06-26244952a6f7'::uuid) AND (ROW(recorded_at, collect_operator_audit.exception_event_id('exception_escalation_event'::text, id)) < ROW('2026-10-01 15:36:07.860693+00'::timestamp with time zone, 'ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid)))
